properties.description: Builds the AR invoice fact: invoices converted to USD, with payments netted off.

typeProperties.script:
source(output(invoice_id as integer, customer_id as integer, invoice_date as date, currency_code as string, invoice_amount as decimal(18,2), status as string),
     allowSchemaDrift: false, format: 'table') ~> Invoices
source(output(rate_date as date, currency_code as string, usd_rate as decimal(18,6)),
     allowSchemaDrift: false, format: 'table') ~> FxRates
source(output(payment_id as integer, invoice_id as integer, payment_date as date, payment_amount as decimal(18,2)),
     allowSchemaDrift: false, format: 'table') ~> Payments
source(output(customer_key as long, customer_id as integer, customer_name as string, country_code as string),
     allowSchemaDrift: false, format: 'table') ~> Customers
// payments summed per invoice
Payments aggregate(groupBy(invoice_id),
     paid_amount = sum(payment_amount)) ~> PaidPerInvoice
Invoices, FxRates join(Invoices@currency_code == FxRates@currency_code && invoice_date == rate_date,
     joinType:'left', broadcast: 'auto') ~> WithRate
WithRate, PaidPerInvoice lookup(Invoices@invoice_id == PaidPerInvoice@invoice_id,
     multiple: false, pickup: 'any', broadcast: 'auto') ~> WithPaid
WithPaid, Customers join(Invoices@customer_id == Customers@customer_id,
     joinType:'inner', broadcast: 'auto') ~> WithCustomer
WithCustomer derive(invoice_amount_usd = round(invoice_amount * usd_rate, 2),
          paid_amount_usd = round(iifNull(paid_amount, 0) * usd_rate, 2),
          open_amount_usd = round((invoice_amount - iifNull(paid_amount, 0)) * usd_rate, 2)) ~> Amounts
Amounts filter(status != 'CANCELLED') ~> OpenOnly
OpenOnly sink(allowSchemaDrift: false, validateSchema: false, format: 'table',
     mapColumn(invoice_id, customer_key, invoice_date, invoice_amount_usd, paid_amount_usd, open_amount_usd, status)) ~> FactInvoice
OpenOnly sink(allowSchemaDrift: true, format: 'delta', fileSystem: 'curated', folderPath: 'finance/fact_ar_invoice',
     mergeSchema: false, autoCompact: true) ~> LakeCopy
